Restorative · Patient guide

Dental implants in Gujranwala

An implant can support a replacement tooth, bridge or denture in suitable patients.

Ask about an appointment →

When might I need it?

Ask about an implant when you have one or more missing teeth. The consultation considers your gums, bone, health history, and options such as a bridge or denture.

What age group is it for?

Generally considered after jaw growth is complete. Bone and gum health and individual health factors matter more than age alone in adults.

What happens at the appointment?

Planning may include imaging. An implant is placed in the jaw, given time to heal, and later restored with the planned replacement tooth or appliance.

Does it hurt?

Placement typically uses local anaesthetic. Some soreness or swelling afterward is possible. Ask about the recovery plan at your consultation.

How much does it cost?

Request an itemised quote covering the implant, abutment and crown. Imaging, bone grafting or extraction can affect the total.

For current pricing and availability, ask the clinic for a quote in PKR based on your assessment.

Plan your visit

Ask the team about availability, the consultation fee, and what to bring. Wait for reception to confirm the date and time.
